facts.value: Examine African and African American history, culture, politics and art to learn how to lead the change for a more equitable society in this online Bachelor of Arts in African and African American Studies. You’ll study global issues that impact African-descended people such as racial formation, institutional racism, African migration, art, literature, religion and education.
